findings.subsystem: Comms: Native BLE, WinUSB, and Mobile Speech API Bindings (R48-04 remainder)
evidence: In crates/mp-core/src/comms.rs:427-517, BleTransport and WinUsbTransport use in-memory parking_lot::Mutex<VecDeque<u8>> buffers instead of binding to platform Bluetooth LE GATT APIs (Windows.Devices.Bluetooth / simpleble / CoreBluetooth) or WinUSB kernel driver IOCTLs (winusb.sys / WinUSBNet).

In crates/mp-app/src/speech.rs:38-47, iOS speech synthesis only logs `iOS AVSpeechSynthesizer: {clean}` to the logger, and Android speech invokes `termux-tts-speak` with a logger fallback. Neither interfaces with native platform TTS frameworks (iOS AVSpeechSynthesizer Objective-C bridge or Android android.speech.tts.TextToSpeech JNI).
findings.impact: Physical Bluetooth Low Energy hardware dongles and WinUSB devices cannot communicate with vehicles on live links. Text-to-speech telemetry callouts remain silent on standard iOS and Android app installs.
findings.required_fix: Bind BleTransport to host BLE GATT services (e.g. SimpleBLE or platform BLE APIs), bind WinUsbTransport to native WinUSB endpoints, and integrate native AVSpeechSynthesizer (iOS) and TextToSpeech (Android) speech engines.

findings.subsystem: Native Delivery: iOS and Android device execution receipts (R48-05 remainder)
evidence: While scripts/build_ios.py and scripts/smoke_ios_simulator.py validate bundling logic via unit tests, no automated CI build artifact (.ipa or .apk) or test execution receipt from physical or simulator mobile runtime has been generated in the current environment.
findings.impact: End-to-end touchscreen interactions, mobile windowing lifecycle, and platform permissions remain unverified on target mobile hardware.
findings.required_fix: Provide automated packaging workflows and verifiable runtime capture receipts from simulator or physical mobile devices.

next_concrete_task: To uncap the score beyond 5.0: (1) Bind BleTransport to native Bluetooth LE GATT APIs (SimpleBLE / platform BLE) and WinUsbTransport to native OS WinUSB device pipes. (2) Replace logging stubs in speech.rs with native iOS AVSpeechSynthesizer FFI and Android TextToSpeech JNI bridges. (3) Generate verifiable mobile build packaging and simulator execution receipts.
